command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# #997 MIGRATION — MIG-06. Find a native Ollama this driver can actually load.
#
# v0.32.15 discovered the P40 correctly (CUDA, compute 6.1, 22.4 GiB, cuda_v12) and offloaded all 29
# layers to it -- then llama-server died at warmup with "the provided PTX was compiled with an
# unsupported toolchain". That is not a Pascal problem. It is a toolkit-vs-driver problem: the
# module's PTX carries an ISA version newer than driver 560.94 (CUDA 12.6) can JIT, so the whole
# module fails to load. The runner even advertises ARCHS ... 1200 (Blackwell, sm_120), which needs
# CUDA 12.8+ to build. The same failure would hit the RTX 3050.
#
# So the question is not "which version supports the P40" -- they all do -- but "which version was
# built with a CUDA toolkit this driver can load". The CUDA runtime DLL each package ships answers
# that directly, so read it rather than infer it from tags and release dates.

$tmp = 'D:\HermesServices\ollama\_probe'
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $tmp | Out-Null
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem

Write-Output "driver_cuda_ceiling=$(& 'C:\Windows\System32\nvidia-smi.exe' --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv,noheader -i 0)"
& 'C:\Windows\System32\nvidia-smi.exe' | Select-String 'CUDA Version' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() }

foreach ($tag in @('v0.31.2', 'v0.30.0', 'v0.24.0', 'v0.21.0', 'v0.18.0')) {
    Write-Output "=== $tag ==="
    $zip = Join-Path $tmp "$tag.zip"
    try {
        $url = "https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/download/$tag/ollama-windows-amd64.zip"
        & curl.exe -L --fail --silent --show-error -o $zip $url 2>&1 | Out-Null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path $zip)) { Write-Output "  download_FAILED rc=$LASTEXITCODE"; continue }
        Write-Output "  zip_bytes=$((Get-Item $zip).Length)"
        $za = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($zip)
        $dirs = $za.Entries | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName } | Where-Object { $_ -match '^lib/ollama/[^/]+/' } |
            ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '/')[2] } | Sort-Object -Unique
        Write-Output "  runner_dirs=$($dirs -join ',')"
        # Pull just the CUDA runtime DLLs out; their file version IS the toolkit version.
        $want = $za.Entries | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^cudart64.*\.dll$|^cublas64.*\.dll$' }
        foreach ($e in $want) {
            $dest = Join-Path $tmp ($e.FullName -replace '/', '_')
            [System.IO.Compression.ZipFileExtensions]::ExtractToFile($e, $dest, $true)
            $fv = (Get-Item $dest).VersionInfo
            Write-Output "  dll=$($e.FullName) file_version=$($fv.FileVersion) product=$($fv.ProductVersion)"
            Remove-Item $dest -Force
        }
        if (-not $want) { Write-Output '  NO_CUDART_SHIPPED' }
        $za.Dispose()
    } catch {
        Write-Output "  ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)"
    } finally {
        Remove-Item $zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
}
Write-Output '=== CURRENT-INSTALL-FOR-COMPARISON ==='
Get-ChildItem 'D:\HermesServices\ollama\dist\lib\ollama' -Recurse -Filter 'cudart64*.dll' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    ForEach-Object { "dll=$($_.FullName.Substring(38)) file_version=$($_.VersionInfo.FileVersion)" }
Get-ChildItem 'D:\HermesServices\ollama\dist\lib\ollama' -Recurse -Filter 'cublas64*.dll' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    ForEach-Object { "dll=$($_.FullName.Substring(38)) file_version=$($_.VersionInfo.FileVersion)" }
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output "d_free_gb=$([math]::Round((Get-Volume -DriveLetter D).SizeRemaining / 1GB, 2))"
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
